Name: Sam is a Butch Woman
Author: Aurekata
Description:
Have you ever felt there is a lack of romancable masc women with short hair in this game? Look no further than this mod!

Sam is now a butch/masculine woman! This mod aims to genderswap Sam without being misogynistic or heteronormative. I feel that genderswap-to-female mods (for any game) often make too much of the focus on cleavage, or change the characters' personality to be more timid or ditzy. This mod does none of that. I aim to be respectful of Sam in this mod.

What this mod changes:
-Sam's sprites and portraits
-Sam's pronouns

What this mod does not change:
-Sam's events and relationships with others
-Sam's personality

What Sam looks like:
-slicked back short hair with an undercut
-her favorite jean jacket
-snakebites
-an eyebrow scar
-eyes are blue/green in portraits and sprites (fixing vanilla continuity errors)
-shirt is red in portraits and sprites (fixing vanilla continuity errors)

Let me know in posts if I missed any pronoun changes or if it doesn't work. Please tell me which scene you had issues with specifically. I am an artist, not a coder, and I clung to the coding wiki and ctrl+F for dear life on this one lol. SVE compatible. Also, the pink text box interface in image one is from the mod "Magical Valley".

Also, Sam's winter outfit is the same as her usual outfit. The real-life reason for this is 90% of the way through making this, I got carpal tunnel in both hands. This mod sat untouched for ~10 months until I realized that releasing it without winter sprites is better than nothing. If you need a lore reason, she's a young and confident butch who loves her jean jacket so much, she wears it even when it's too cold.
